text:
jamal: Hi everyone  accepted the org invite and verified email, but I can't see the private infra repo. When I try to clone I get a 404. Also the SSO flow asked me to register a security key (I have a YubiKey) and then it failed to finish. Who should I ask? cc @zoe

zoe: welcome jamal! that sounds like two separate issues: repo visibility (maybe you're an outside collaborator) and the 2FA device not finishing enrollment. can you paste the exact clone error and what account name shows in the invite email?

jamal: Clone error:
```
$ git clone git@github.com:redwood-inference/infra.git
Cloning into 'infra'...
ERROR: Repository not found.
fatal: Could not read from remote repository.
Please make sure you have the correct access rights and the repository exists.
```
Invite email said: "You've been invited to join the redwood-inference org as jamal.dev (accepted)". I think my GitHub handle is jamal.dev. I did accept the invite from that account.

it-support: thanks. quick checks: 1) are you listed as a full member vs outside collaborator? outside collaborators cannot see private org repos unless explicitly invited. 2) the YubiKey flow sometimes fails if the browser blocks USB or has an old security key registration. Which browser did you use?

jamal: Chrome on Mac. When I tried to finish the security key step it popped a browser dialog, I touched the YubiKey, then it refreshed and said "Verification incomplete".

onboarding-bot: FYI: org policy requires SAML SSO + 2FA hardware (or TOTP) for full member access. Until SSO enforcement completes you may be stuck as outside collaborator.

zoe: okay, I'll check the org console. @it-support can you confirm if jamal.dev is currently an outside collaborator and whether the infra repo has a team ACL?

it-support: checking... infra repo is restricted to team "eng-infra". jamal.dev is currently listed as an outside collaborator (accepted invite but never completed SSO enforcement). I can convert to a member but SSO needs to be completed first per policy. Two immediate options: a) finish 2FA hardware enrollment (try Safari or a different USB port, or register as TOTP temporarily), or b) we can add you directly to the repo as an invited collaborator while you finish SSO (short-term). Which do you prefer?

jamal: I can try another browser first. Anything special to unblock the YubiKey on mac?

zoe: on mac you might need to enable "Use USB security keys" under chrome://flags if it's blocked, but Safari tends to have smoother WebAuthn for YubiKey. Also check System Preferences -> Security -> allow interactions for the browser. If that doesn't work, register a TOTP authenticator (authy/google) temporarily under Settings -> Security -> Two-factor authentication -> Set up TOTP, then finish SSO to upgrade role.

jamal: switched to Safari and it accepted the key! SSO flow completed and I got a success banner.

ci-bot: Access change detected: user jamal.dev SSO status = enforced.

it-support: I toggled your membership from outside collaborator to member now that SSO shows enforced. You should get repo access in a minute. Try cloning again.

jamal: cloning now... success! pulled infra. Thanks! Also saw an automated invite to eng-infra team appear.

zoe: great. follow-up for the onboarding checklist: add a note about trying Safari for YubiKey enrollment and that outside-collaborator status prevents private repo access. I'll update the doc.

jamal: leaving a tip: if your personal GH account used the same email you might get weird behavior; make sure the account that accepts the invite is the one you plan to use for work.

it-support: resolved 14 marking thread closed. :white_check_mark:
